notes.title: 2025/1/4 Game Update
notes.notes:
Boss fights and several related bosses have been added to certain maps
Fixed some known bugs and related improvements

notes.title: Update the leaderboard
notes.notes: Added leaderboard features, including the highest number of days to survive and the gold ranking

notes.title: 12/31 update patch
notes.notes:
What's in this patch:
1. Remove Yellow Sand Weather
2. Fixed the problem that the dungeon client and the server map were out of sync when online
3. Fixed the issue that the client could not remove the facehug through melee attack normally when online
4. Reduced the difficulty of solving puzzles on the Backrooms map
5. Adjust the explosion rate of enemy crystal nuclei
6. Reduced the damage of friendly bazookas and grenades
7. Fixed the problem that the client was not working properly when submitting task items when online
8. Added unlimited upgrades to weapons
9. Adjust the different upgrade attributes of each weapon to balance the weapon values
10. Fixed the dungeon map error when the client was online

notes.title: 12/30 Mini Patch
notes.notes:
What's in this patch:
1. Fixed the problem that the guide box could not be closed after entering the initial map in the beginner tutorial
2. Fixed weapon bonuses not being displayed during modifications
3. Fixed the issue of incorrect magazine size of weapons
4. Fixed the maze map character being knocked away by monsters
5. Changed the non-ability to shoot while dancing
6. Increase the upper limit of 2048 to 120 yuan
7. Miscellaneous

notes.title: Update announcements
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing this game, due to the short beta time of the game, there were many bugs and optimization problems when the game was released, and I am trying my best to fix them urgently.
I apologize to all players who played this game, and I promise that the game will gradually improve the content in the future, and do my best to fix bugs and optimizations! Thank you for your visit and have fun!

What's in this patch:
1. Optimized the smoke at the evacuation point
2. Increase the strength of monsters in the early game
3. Increased the detection of dagger attack range
4. Fixed incorrect multiplayer magazine size
5. Fixed the issue that the weapon was not stuck at the beginning
6. Reduced friendly damage
7. Increase the brightness of some map scenes
8. Other minor optimizations

notes.title: Minor update optimization + bug fixing
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that dancing sometimes could not quit normally
2. Add the function of one-click sales according to the quality of the item
3. Increase the brightness of the maze map
4. Fixed the bug that the final hunting ground would fall out of the void
5. Optimized the stability of joining a room online
